subject: Acme POC \u0014 next steps & eval methodology
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-01-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Acme POC  next steps & eval methodology

Hi Samantha 

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier today. As discussed, I wanted to capture the agreed next steps and clarify how we should run evaluations during the 6-week POC. High level:

- Success criteria (your ask):
  - 95% intent classification accuracy on your internal test set OR a measurable lift in task completion for the top-3 flows vs baseline.
  - 99th percentile latency <= 400ms for 1-2 concurrent users in the shadow environment.
  - No PII leakage in outputs (we'll run the sample redaction checks).

- Proposed evaluation plan (see attached: acme_poc_eval_plan_v2.pdf):
  - Week 0: onboarding, dataset ingestion, and config sync.
  - Week 1-2: offline evals against your labelled dataset (we'll run micro-batches and provide metric dashboards).
  - Week 3-4: online shadow mode (traffic replay) to validate latency and safety under realistic load.
  - Week 5: manual QA pass with rubric + stakeholder review.
  - Week 6: final report and decision gate.

- Ownership & roles:
  - Redwood: model serving, shadow infra, metrics dashboard, security checklist. (Owner: me)
  - Acme: provide labelled dataset (by EOD Jan 19), agree on sample traffic for shadow replay, and sign the POC SOW. (Owner: Samantha)

- Evaluation methodology alignment question we flagged on the call: offline evals (fast, deterministic) vs online shadow (true-to-prod but more work). We recommend running both  offline first to iterate on prompts and weighting, then shadow to validate latency and safety. The attached plan includes grading rubric draft.

Next steps: can you confirm dataset delivery date and available windows for a 2-hour kickoff next week?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_poc_eval_plan_v2.pdf (6 pages)

Marissa 

Thanks for the thorough recap. Confirming: we can deliver the labelled dataset by Jan 18 (we need to do a final scrub). A couple quick clarifications:

1) For "95% intent classification accuracy"  is that measured on macro or micro avg? We typically report macro F1.
2) For the shadow run, we can provide a replay of last 7 days of traffic (anonymized). Do you recommend any sampling?

Also  who from Redwood will be the day-to-day contact for the shadow run (ops/infra)?

Would be good to get the rubric up front so our product QA can review.

Best,
Samantha Lopez

Samantha 

Thanks  great questions. Quick answers below and attaching the eval plan + rubric for review.

1) Metric framing: we'll report both macro F1 and micro accuracy in the dashboard; for the decision gate we can use macro F1 if that aligns with your QA. We'll call out which metric is primary in the final report.

2) Shadow sampling: start with a 10% uniform sample of last 7 days, then expand to 25% if results look stable. We'll run traffic replay in a non-prod VPC and redact any remaining PII before it touches the service.

3) Day-to-day ops: Dylan Brooks (dylan.brooks@redwood.ai) will lead shadow infra and runbooks; Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.ai) will lead evals and QA instrumentation.

Attached: acme_poc_eval_plan_v2.pdf, eval_rubric_v1.xlsx

Proposed kickoff: Jan 19, 10am-12pm PST. Does that work?

Cheers,
Marissa

Linking in a few operational notes on the grading rubric and shadow setup. Inline below.

> 1) Metric framing: we'll report both macro F1 and micro accuracy...

Suggestion for rubric (short):
- Automated metrics (objective, reproducible): macro F1, micro accuracy, latency p95/p99, token-level safety score (auto-check).
- Human review (subjective): sample-level correctness, hallucination rate, and suitability score (0-3). We should sample 200 examples per week for manual review during the shadow run.
- Pass/fail gate: macro F1 >= threshold AND human suitability average >= 2.5.

Operational pieces:
- We'll provision shadow cluster in us-west-2, isolated VPC.
- Traffic replay tooling: we'll use replay service v2  requires a 7d compressed ndjson export.
- Secret handling: Acme should send any required API keys via our SSO vault (I'll provide the onboarding doc at kickoff).

I'll prepare the runbook and share before kickoff.

- Dylan
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Samantha / Marissa 

I've attached a concise rubric (eval_rubric_v1.xlsx) and populated the thresholds we discussed. Summary here:

- Primary metric: macro F1 >= 0.95 (on your labelled test set)
- Latency: p99 <= 400ms during 10% shadow sampling
- Human suitability: average >= 2.5/3 across 200 sampled responses weekly
- Safety: zero high-severity PII incidents during shadow (auto-block + manual review)

If you're OK with these thresholds, we'll mark the rubric as final and begin the offline evals the week of Jan 18.

Requested action: Samantha  please sign the SOW (DocuSign link below) and confirm dataset delivery on Jan 18. We'll schedule the kickoff for Jan 19 10-12 PST once SOW is in place.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
